messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] High tail latency and elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1 serving tier. Investigate immediately. Logs: link to alert -> https://monitor.redwood.ai/alerts/4162003456

sam_eng: acked, joining. can someone grab warroom?

maria_sre: I'm on call, opening war room now. https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/4162003456 - joining in 30s :wave:

jack_prodeng: seeing increased p50->p95 step-ups in the tracing dashboard, probable KV cache thrash after deploy? confirming no recent config changes on dedicated pools.

maria_sre: confirmed warmup check spikes at 13:02 UTC, correlates with a rolling deploy on eu-west-1 earlier. adding deploy tags to timeline.

sam_eng: ops-bot, can you post the most recent deployment metadata here?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment event: service=redwood-serving, env=eu-west-1, deploy_id=deploy-2026-03-17-13:00, author=@ci-bot. Links -> https://deploys.redwood.ai/deploy-2026-03-17-13:00

maria_sre: assigning owner: maria_sre will lead immediate mitigation and rollback coordination. sam_eng you are secondary.

sam_eng: noted. I'll prepare rollback playbook and patch route suggestions.

laura_cs: flagged customers with SLOs in eu-west-1 - will prepare a short customer-facing note once we have impact summary. how many customers affected? rough count?

maria_sre: quick impact triage: approx 18 customer tenants showing increased latency or sporadic errors, most traffic in the 3 top accounts. no full region outage; degraded tail latency and a 5xx spike ~12-15% on some endpoints.

jack_prodeng: quick sanity check command for service health if anyone needs to run locally:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://eu-west-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq
```

maria_sre: running KV cache metrics query now, sharing snippet:```
SELECT percentile(latency, 95), errors FROM serving.requests WHERE region="eu-west-1" AND timeframe=5m
```
result: p95 increased from 240ms -> 980ms, errors from 0.6% -> 12% in window.

sam_eng: propose immediate mitigation: 1) pause rolling deploy (if still running), 2) scale up read-replicas for the affected pool, 3) enable fallback model variant for high-latency paths. need ops-bot to throttle new rollouts.

ops-bot: action: paused further rollouts for service=redwood-serving in eu-west-1. autoscale triggered +2 nodes to pool id pool-eu-12.

maria_sre: I'm starting a canary rollback to previous deploy on a small subset of hosts to verify. will update in warroom.

laura_cs: drafting quick status page blurb for ops review: "We are investigating elevated latency for inference endpoints in eu-west-1, some customers may see slower responses or intermittent errors. Our engineers are working on mitigation; updates every 30 minutes." any changes?

sam_eng: change tone to "targeted impact" and call out mitigation steps: add "We have paused the recent rollout and are initiating a rollback while enabling increased capacity." keep ETA TBD.

laura_cs: updated draft: "We are investigating a targeted increase in latency and error rates affecting inference endpoints in eu-west-1. We have paused a recent rollout and are initiating rollback and capacity increases. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." publishing if no objections. :memo:

jack_prodeng: no objections. also recommend include a link to support ticket route for impacted customers.

laura_cs: added support link and published initial status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/4162003456 - queued for markdown review.

maria_sre: rollback started on canary hosts, p95 back down to ~260ms on canary after 4 min. continuing to roll back gradually.

sam_eng: good signal. once rollback fully completes we should run a short soak and then confirm with metrics before closing P1.

ops-bot: note: on-call handoff scheduled in 45m, current oncall will remain owner until next handoff unless incident severity drops.

maria_sre: leaving short action list in warroom: 1) finish rollback across eu-west-1 2) monitor p95 and error rate for 30m post-rollback 3) follow-up postmortem owner=jack_prodeng.

laura_cs: will prepare customer notification template for affected tenants; holding until we have final impact window. drafting in #customer-comms to loop in AE.

sam_eng: thanks team. will update when rollback completes or if new anomalies surface.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: rollback progressing, canary p95 recovered. next update in 20m or on state change.
